## `neuro.array.map`

Instance method on `Array.prototype`.

> Calls a defined callback function on each element of an array, and returns an array that contains the results.

## Signatures

```ts
map(input: { array: <receiver>; callbackfn?: (value: T; index: number; array: T[]) => U; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<U[]>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Array.prototype.map` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
